scope: Source-only r2 hardening of the M1163 final Motion checkpoint selector. It closes JSON bool/number type confusion in all load-audit zero counters, enforces exactly the five predeclared epoch profile directories, and requires exactly one anchored aee ranking declaration. It selects nothing now and grants no hardware replay authority.

m1165_findings_closed.finding: Python false equals integer zero under equality
m1165_findings_closed.fix: For missing_count, unexpected_count, overlay_missing_count and overlay_unexpected_count require type(value) is int and value == 0.

m1165_findings_closed.finding: Fixed-loop selection silently accepted an extra epoch99 profile directory despite an exactly-five contract
m1165_findings_closed.fix: Enumerate standard_valid825/epoch[0-9]+ non-symlink directories and require the observed set equals {9,14,19,24,29}.

m1165_findings_closed.finding: Substring search accepted ranking documents containing both candidate and aee declarations
m1165_findings_closed.fix: Parse anchored ranking declaration lines and require the declaration list is exactly [aee].

inherited_selection_gate.load_audit: all four counters exact non-bool int zero and overlay key counts exactly 210/210
inherited_selection_gate.ranking: exactly one anchored ranking_mode=aee declaration and five-row exact-AEE order
inherited_selection_gate.selection: minimum exact standard-valid825 AEE, lowest epoch tie break
inherited_selection_gate.outputs: selected checkpoint SHA/size/mtime, five-checkpoint metric/activity table and E0-E8 invalidation/rebind targets

exact_next_execution_gate.prerequisite_0: M1165 or another different-author hammer passes this exact r2 source, tests and contract
exact_next_execution_gate.prerequisite_1: the existing standard valid825 process exits successfully without interruption
exact_next_execution_gate.prerequisite_2: the only standard_valid825 epoch directories are epoch9/14/19/24/29 and all profiles pass the inherited gate
exact_next_execution_gate.action: Run the exact-SHA r2 builder once on the remote repository. It reads/hashes existing artifacts and writes only a small sealed binder receipt; it starts no GPU or EDA work.
exact_next_execution_gate.post_action: Copy only the small sealed binder receipt to a different author for a result hammer. No E1 deployment evaluation or E2-E8 hardware rebind may start before that result hammer passes.
